description: This file defines the CampaignROIChartDashlet class, a custom dashboard widget for displaying ROI charts related to campaigns within a SuiteCRM/SugarCRM environment. It extends a generic chart dashlet class and includes methods for rendering the dashlet, constructing data queries, and preparing chart data based on campaign metrics.

classes.name: CampaignROIChartDashlet
classes.description: A dashlet class responsible for rendering ROI charts for campaigns, including data fetching and chart rendering logic.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Displays options for the dashlet, such as selecting campaigns, by retrieving campaign list and populating options.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the chart dashlet, constructing data, preparing chart options, and generating the HTML/JavaScript for the chart.

methods.name: constructQuery
methods.description: Builds and executes database queries to gather campaign-related metrics such as total value, revenue, investment, budget, and expected revenue.

methods.name: prepareChartData
methods.description: Processes raw data into structured labels and datasets suitable for rendering as a chart, formatting numbers and organizing labels.
